# Image

Create images from a description: photos, pictures, illustrations, art, characters and scenes in any aspect ratio. Generated in seconds and saved to your MegaScenes library.

## What it does
Describe the picture and the look you want. Claude picks a model (Nano Banana 2 by default; GPT Image, Seedream, Flux, Ideogram and others on request), tells you the price, and creates the image in your account. Ask for variations or another aspect ratio in the same chat.

**How the files are made:** The files are generated by image, video and audio models that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you ask, and the price in credits is shown first.

Creates new images from text. To edit your own photo, upload it on the MegaScenes site.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install image@megascenes
```

## Setup
The plugin connects Claude to the MegaScenes MCP server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/image/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting asks you to sign in to MegaScenes (OAuth with PKCE); you can create an account on the same page, and you come straight back to the chat.
- Creating uses the credits on your MegaScenes account, and the price is shown before anything runs. New accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- Where Claude supports interactive apps, results appear in a live viewer; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_image_models` | Models for images with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_image_cost` | Exact price of one image before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_image` | Starts one image in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_image` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A cozy reading nook with rain on the window, watercolor"
- "Four variations of a cyberpunk fox mascot, square"
- "A 16:9 banner of a mountain lake at sunrise"

## Data and privacy
Your prompts, settings and the files you choose are sent to MegaScenes and kept in your MegaScenes account, and they are sent to the model provider that makes the file. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
- Privacy policy: https://megascenes.com/legal/privacy
- Terms of service: https://megascenes.com/legal/terms
